title: REQ · Header explains round failure and offers Retry
summary: HeaderOverlay error state shows an explained cause and a Retry button instead of a bare message
description: Context: HeaderOverlay.tsx (L1-L44) shows 'Round unavailable: {error}' only. Desired behavior: accept an optional onRetry prop and render a Retry button in the error state with explanatory text. Expected result: users can retry a failed round load. Why: avoid a dead-end error.
acceptance_criteria: Given error and onRetry, when rendered, then alert text includes the cause and a Retry button is shown
When Retry is clicked, then onRetry is called once
Given no error, then no Retry button is rendered
definition_of_done: Retry rendered in error state only
